blocks.text: Ask any everyday Filipino entrepreneur, salaried worker, or retiree what stands between a good plan and real progress, and the answer rarely comes down to a lack of grit. More often, it comes down to timing. It is about having the right financial breathing room when an opportunity knocks or an unexpected expense arrives. For Alpha Floen Financial, operating under RT Floen Lending Investor Corporation, lending isn’t simply about releasing funds and waiting for due dates. Having served more than 300 clients and counting, backed by a loyal base of repeat borrowers, the Davao-based brand has quietly built a following by […]...
